source: Good Sam directory (PUBLIC_PARK and local-named rows with no entry within 2 km) and every named OSM tourism=camp_site/caravan_site with no entry within 1.5 km, read by name
note: Four local-government campgrounds added: Battle Row (Nassau County), Onoville Marina Park (Cattaraugus County), Korn's Campground (Town of Wallkill) and Sheridan Bay Park (Town of Sheridan). Excluded: seasonal-dominated town parks (Bulwagga Bay, Champ RV Park, Monitor Bay), a discontinued one (Mountaindale), Suffolk's 4WD outer-beach camping (Shinnecock East, Cupsogue, Montauk County Park), no-web-presence Santway Park. Finding: NY's STATE coverage is thin - several DEC and OPRHP campgrounds (Rogers Rock, Luzerne, Forked Lake, Alger Island, Moose River Plains, Buttermilk Falls) are absent; NY needs a state pass. ~150 private campgrounds are also unmatched.

excluded.name: Champ RV Park / Port Henry Champ Beach (Town of Moriah)
excluded.why: 'many sites taken by seasonal guests'; satellite shows a packed seasonal-trailer layout

excluded.name: Shinnecock East County Park (Suffolk)
excluded.why: outer-beach self-contained camping on soft sand; four-wheel drive essential - fails normal-vehicle access

excluded.name: Cupsogue Beach County Park (Suffolk)
excluded.why: outer-beach camping along the beach access road under Suffolk's outer-beach Recreational Vehicle Permit - same class as Shinnecock East; normal-vehicle access not shown

excluded.name: Monitor Bay Campsite (Town of Crown Point)
excluded.why: town fee sheet lists seasonal rates only (resident/non-resident seasonal) - a seasonal campground

excluded.name: Santway Park (Village of Theresa)
excluded.why: no live web presence - no village page with rates/phone and no bookable listing; directories list it as free dispersed

excluded.name: Montauk County Park / Theodore Roosevelt County Park RV camping (Suffolk)
excluded.why: self-contained outer-beach camping on sand - campers must air down tires; fails normal-vehicle access

excluded.name: Woodsmen's / Boonville camping fairgrounds
excluded.why: event camping at the Woodsmen's Field Days grounds

other.name: (state gap)
other.why: NY was never swept against the DEC/OPRHP rosters: unmatched and absent from the DB are DEC Rogers Rock, Luzerne, Forked Lake, Alger Island, Moose River Plains, Lake George Islands (boat-in) and OPRHP Buttermilk Falls, among others; NY holds only 102 state entries. Needs its own state pass.

other.name: (private gap)
other.why: ~150 of NY's 325 unmatched named OSM campsites are private campgrounds - outside this pass
